paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 这篇论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由语言模型（LM）与 agent-computer interface（ACI）组成的系统，用于自主解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。作者认为 LM agent 是一类新的终端用户，需要专门设计的接口，并据此设计了包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件的 ACI [S2.p1][S3.p1]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 成绩，超过此前非交互式 LM 的最好结果 [abstract]。消融实验表明，ACI 设计选择对 agent 行为与性能有显著影响 [S1.p4][S5.SS1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：语言模型 agent 能否像人类工程师从 IDE 等软件中获益一样，从专门设计的接口中获益，从而完成软件工程这类复杂任务 [S1.p1]。作者指出，现有接口是为人类用户设计的，而 LM agent 代表一类具有自身需求与能力的新终端用户 [S2.p1]。其动机在于，LM agent 直接使用 Linux shell 时难以可靠地执行操作，例如无法提供编辑小段文件的简单命令，且对无效编辑不给出反馈，这些缺陷严重妨碍了性能 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
it fails to provide simple commands to edit a small file segment, and does not provide any feedback if the user makes an invalid edit.
These deficits substantially hamper performance, motivating the need for an agent-computer interface (ACI)

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 与 ACI 组成的系统，其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，并配有 guardrails 防止常见错误，每一步都向 agent 返回具体而简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，agent 每步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，并将命令执行反馈纳入后续输入 [S3.p1]。设计遵循四条原则：动作应简单易懂、动作应紧凑高效、环境反馈应信息丰富但简洁、guardrails 应能缓解错误传播并加速恢复 [S2.p5]。作者在固定 LM 的前提下，通过人工检查 agent 行为和网格搜索来选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
At each step, SWE-agent generates a thought and a command, then incorporates the feedback from the command’s execution in the environment
Actions should be simple and easy to understand for agents.
Actions should be compact and efficient.
Environment feedback should be informative but concise.
Guardrails mitigate error propagation and hasten recovery.
we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance
run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2,294 个任务实例；消融与分析在 SWE-bench Lite 上进行，该子集包含 300 个实例，聚焦自包含的功能性 bug 修复 [S4.p1]。此外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本的代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。所有结果、消融和分析基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。对比基线包括非交互式检索增强生成（RAG）和仅使用 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 设置 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 推理成本，单实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines established in.
The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework introduced in.
We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric
we set the per-instance budget to $4; if a run exceeded this budget, existing edits were submitted automatically.

findings.text: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最佳，解决了完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。相比 Lite 上的 RAG，SWE-agent 成本高 8–13 倍，但 % Resolved 率提升 6.7 倍；相比同样使用 GPT-4 Turbo 的 Shell-only，相对提升 64% [S5.p1]。在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 [S5.p2]。消融显示，Iterative search 在大量搜索结果时表现甚至差于没有额外搜索工具（15.7% vs. 12.0%），无文件编辑器时性能降至 10.3%，无 linting 时降至 15.0% [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS1.p5]。行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现和/或定位问题，随后进入“编辑—执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；2,294 个任务中有 1,185 个（51.7%）的轨迹出现至少一次失败编辑，编辑尝试最终成功概率为 90.5%，但一次失败后降至 57.2% [S5.SS2.p4]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
compared to RAG on Lite, SWE-agent is $8$ - $13$ x more costly but yields a $6.7$ -fold improved % Resolved rate.
An LM-friendly ACI’s value is confirmed by SWE-agent’s $64$ % relative increase compared to Shell-only, both with GPT-4 Turbo.
SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
leading to even worse performance than the not having additional search tools at all ( $15.7$ % $\downarrow$ 2.3 for No search vs. $12.0$ % $\downarrow$ 6.0 with Iterative search).
Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
This intervention improves performance considerably (without linting, $15.0$ % $\downarrow$ 3.0).
SWE-agent usually begins with either writing reproduction code and/or localizing the issue’s cause to specific lines of code.
from turn $5$ onwards, the most frequent two actions for all turns are edit and python.
out of $2,294$ task instances, $1,185$ ( $51.7$ %) of SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo trajectories have $1$ + failed edits.
Any attempt at editing has a $90.5$ % chance of eventually being successful. This probability drops off to $57.2$ % after a single failed edit.
